segments.ko_txt: - 132-05 시험에서 UGT1A1 유전형에서 전체 노출기간은 모든 유형에서 유사하였으나, 용량감량은 *28/28에서 높았음.
segments.en_txt: - In study 132-05, the overall exposure duration was similar across all UGT1A1 genotypes; however, dose reduction was higher in *28/28.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.5.유효성 및 안전성.6.5.8. 안전성 결과에 대한 요약 및 결론[39]
segments.ko_txt: - SAE는 UGT1A1 대립유전자 *28/28에서 SAE 38.2%, 약물 관련 SAE 29.4%, 용량감량을 유도한 AE 35.3%, 영구중단을 유도한 AE 5.9%로 다른 대립유전자 유형 보다 더 높았음.
segments.en_txt: - In UGT1A1 allele *28/28, SAEs were 38.2%, drug-related SAEs 29.4%, AEs leading to dose reduction 35.3%, and AEs leading to permanent discontinuation 5.9%, all of which were higher than in other allele genotypes.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.5.유효성 및 안전성.6.5.8. 안전성 결과에 대한 요약 및 결론[40]
segments.ko_txt: - 132-05 시험에서 호중구감소증, 설사, 빈혈, 식욕감소, 기침, 변비, 말초부종, 열성호중구감소증, 점막 염증에서 *28/28 동형접합성에서 다른 유전형에 비하여 발생빈도가 높았으며, 132-05, 132-01 두 시험 통합 시 빈혈, 열성 호중구감소증, 호중구감소증, 식욕감소는 *28/28 동형접합성에서 더 높았음.
segments.en_txt: - In study 132-05, the incidence was higher in *28/28 homozygotes than in other genotypes for neutropenia, diarrhea, anemia, decreased appetite, cough, constipation, peripheral edema, febrile neutropenia, and mucosal inflammation; in the integrated analysis of studies 132-05 and 132-01, anemia, febrile neutropenia, neutropenia, and decreased appetite were higher in *28/28 homozygotes.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.5.유효성 및 안전성.6.5.8. 안전성 결과에 대한 요약 및 결론[41]
segments.ko_txt: 구토, 오심, 설사 등 위장관계 AE는 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: Gastrointestinal AEs such as vomiting, nausea, and diarrhea were similar.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.5.유효성 및 안전성.6.5.9. 유익성-위해성 평가(CTD 2.5.6) (신약만 해당)[0]
segments.ko_txt: • mTNBC는 예후가 좋지 않으며 생존기간 중앙값은 약 13개월로 추정되며 이전 2가지 이상 전신치료를 받은 적이 있고 이 중 한번은 전이성 질환에서 치료받은 재발 또는 불응인 mTNBC 환자에 대한 치료제는 의학적 미충족 상태임.
segments.en_txt: • mTNBC has a poor prognosis, with median survival estimated at approximately 13 months, and there is an unmet medical need for treatments for relapsed or refractory mTNBC patients who have received at least 2 prior systemic therapies, of which one was for metastatic disease.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.5.유효성 및 안전성.6.5.9. 유익성-위해성 평가(CTD 2.5.6) (신약만 해당)[1]
segments.ko_txt: • 전이성인 경우 2가지 이상의 이전 치료 경험이 있는 환자에서 이용 가능한 치료제는 국내에서 에리불린이 있으며 카페시타빈, 비노렐빈 등이 사용 가능함.
segments.en_txt: • For metastatic disease, available treatments for patients with at least 2 prior therapies include eribulin in Korea, and capecitabine, vinorelbine, etc. may also be used.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.5.유효성 및 안전성.6.5.9. 유익성-위해성 평가(CTD 2.5.6) (신약만 해당)[2]
segments.ko_txt: 에리불린의 경우 3차 요법에서의 ORR은 11%였음.
segments.en_txt: For eribulin, the ORR in third-line therapy was 11%.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.5.유효성 및 안전성.6.5.9. 유익성-위해성 평가(CTD 2.5.6) (신약만 해당)[3]
segments.ko_txt: TNBC에 대하여 허가된 약물은 아테졸리주맙과 펨브롤리주맙이 있으나 아테졸리주맙은 PD-L1 발현 ≥1%에서 1차 요법으로, 펨브롤리주맙은 PD-L1 발현≥10)에서 재발 또는 전이성 환자에 대하여 허가되었음.
segments.en_txt: Drugs approved for TNBC include atezolizumab and pembrolizumab; however, atezolizumab is approved as first-line therapy in PD-L1 expression ≥1%, and pembrolizumab is approved for relapsed or metastatic patients with PD-L1 expression ≥10).

segments.ko_txt: • SG는 핵심임상시험에서 신청 질환 환자에 대하여 뇌전이가 없는 환자에서 대조군 대비 PFS HR 0.41(p<0.0001), 전체 ITT 집단에서 PFS HR 0.43(p<0.0001)로 대조군 대비 우월성을 입증하였으며 BRCA, UGT1A1, PD-1/PD-L1 치료 유무에 따른 하위분석에서도 일관된 개선을 보였음.
segments.en_txt: • In the pivotal clinical trial, SG demonstrated superiority versus control in the indicated patient population: in patients without brain metastases, PFS HR 0.41 (p<0.0001), and in the overall ITT population, PFS HR 0.43 (p<0.0001); consistent improvements were also observed in subgroup analyses according to BRCA, UGT1A1, and prior PD-1/PD-L1 treatment.

segments.en_txt: • The most commonly reported AEs with SG were gastrointestinal events (diarrhea, vomiting, nausea, etc.) and myelosuppression (neutropenia, anemia, etc.), and these are manageable through dose modification and monitoring.

segments.ko_txt: • 신청 질환은 ‘이전에 두 번 이상의 전신치료를 받은 적이 있고, 그 중 적어도 한 번은 전이성 질환에서 치료를 받은, 절제 불가능한 국소진행성 또는 전이성 삼중음성유방암 (mTNBC) 성인 환자의 치료’임.
segments.en_txt: • The proposed indication is the ‘treatment of adult patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (mTNBC) who have received two or more prior systemic therapies, at least one of which was for metastatic disease’.

segments.ko_txt: • 현재 1 또는 2차 치료후 재발 또는 불응인 유방한 치료제로 제한적인 항암화학요법(카페시타빈, 비노렐빈, 알부빈 결합 파클리탁셀, 에리불린 등)이 있으며 mTNBC 환자에서의 예후는 좋지 않아 ORR은 10~15%, PFS는 2~3개월로 추정됨.
segments.en_txt: • Currently, treatment options for breast cancer relapsed or refractory after first- or second-line therapy are limited to chemotherapy (capecitabine, vinorelbine, albumin-bound paclitaxel, eribulin, etc.), and prognosis in mTNBC patients is poor, with ORR estimated at 10–15% and PFS at 2–3 months.

segments.ko_txt: TNBC 환자에서 허가된 약물은 1차 요법으로 아테졸리주맙(PD-L1 발현≥1%, 알부민 결합 파크리탁셀과의 병용요법), 재발 또는 전이성에 대해 펨브롤리주맙(PD-L1 발현 양성(CPS≥10), 수술이 불가능한 국소 재발성 또는 전이성 삼중음성 유방암에서 항암화학요법과의 병용)이 있으며, germline BRCA 변이 HER2-음성인 국소 진행성 또는 전이성 유방암 환자에서 올라파립, 탈라조파립이 있음.
segments.en_txt: Approved drugs in TNBC include atezolizumab as first-line therapy (PD-L1 expression ≥1%, in combination with albumin-bound paclitaxel) and pembrolizumab for relapsed or metastatic disease (PD-L1 expression positive (CPS≥10), in combination with chemotherapy in unresectable locally recurrent or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer); olaparib and talazoparib are available for patients with germline BRCA-mutated, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.

segments.ko_txt: • 따라서 이전 2가지 이상 전신치료를 받고 이 중 최소 한번은 전이성 질환에서 치료를 받은 국소진행성 또는 전이성 TNBC 환자의 치료는 현존하는 치료제가 제한적이며 예후가 좋지 않고 의학적 미충족에 해당함.
segments.en_txt: • Therefore, for locally advanced or metastatic TNBC patients who have received at least 2 prior systemic therapies, including at least one for metastatic disease, existing treatment options are limited, prognosis is poor, and this represents an unmet medical need.

segments.ko_txt: • 신청 질환에 대한 안전성 및 유효성 입증자료로서 이전 두 가지 이상 치료를 받은 전이성 3중 음성 유방암(mTNBC) 성인 환자에서 사시투주맙 고비테칸(SG) 대 physician choice 치료(TPC)를 비교한 다국가, 다기관, 공개라벨, 무작위배정 3상 임상시험이 제출되었음.
segments.en_txt: • As evidence to demonstrate safety and efficacy for the proposed indication, a multinational, multicenter, open-label, randomized Phase 3 clinical trial comparing sacituzumab govitecan (SG) with physician’s choice treatment (TPC) in adult patients with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (mTNBC) who had received at least two prior therapies was submitted.

segments.ko_txt: • 대조군(TPC군)으로 TPC는 에리불린, 카페시타빈, 젬시타빈, 에리불빈 중 1가지가 선택되었으며 이는 국내에서도 2차 이상 치료에 실패한 진행성 유방암 환자에 적용되는 약물로 대조군으로서 인정 가능함.
segments.en_txt: • As the control group (TPC group), one of eribulin, capecitabine, gemcitabine, and eribulin was selected as TPC; these are drugs applied domestically to advanced breast cancer patients who failed second-line or later therapy, and are acceptable as a control group.

segments.ko_txt: • 총 529명이 SG군과 TPC군에 1:1 무작위배정되었으며 이 중 뇌전이가 없는 1차 유효성 분석군은 총 468명으로 SG 235명 vs. TPC 233명이었음(뇌전이가 있는 환자 SG 32명, TPC 29명) 두 군의 인구학적 특성 및 베이스라인에서의 질환 상태는 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: • A total of 529 patients were randomized 1:1 to the SG group and the TPC group; among them, the primary efficacy analysis population without brain metastases comprised 468 patients (SG 235 vs. TPC 233) (patients with brain metastases: SG 32, TPC 29). Demographics and baseline disease status were similar between the two groups.

segments.ko_txt: 뇌전이가 없는 환자에서 이전 치료 차수는 대부분 2~3이었으며, >3인 경우는 약 29%였음.
segments.en_txt: Among patients without brain metastases, the number of prior lines of therapy was mostly 2–3, and approximately 29% had >3.

segments.ko_txt: 약 70%가 원발성 TNBC였고, UGT1A1 대립유전자형 분석은 SG군에서만 수행되었으며 *28/28은 12.8%가 포함되었음.
segments.en_txt: Approximately 70% had primary TNBC, and UGT1A1 allele genotype analysis was performed only in the SG group, with *28/28 included in 12.8%.

segments.ko_txt: BRCA1/BRCA2 변이 양성은 약 7%가 포함되었음.
segments.en_txt: BRCA1/BRCA2 mutation positive was included in approximately 7%.

segments.ko_txt: 전체 ITT군에서 질환 특성은 두 군에서 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: In the overall ITT population, disease characteristics were similar between the two groups.

segments.ko_txt: 이전 요법으로 가장 흔한 전신요법은 시클로포스파미드, 파클리탁셀, 카보플라틴, 카페시타빈 등이었으며 PD-1/PD-L1 치료는 약 27%가 받았음.
segments.en_txt: The most common prior systemic therapies were cyclophosphamide, paclitaxel, carboplatin, and capecitabine, and approximately 27% received PD-1/PD-L1 therapy.

segments.ko_txt: - ITT군에서 뇌 방사선 치료 경험이 있는 환자는 SG 32명, TPC 31명으로 총 63명이었으나 뇌전이가 있는 환자 분석(Brain metastasis positive Ad hoc table)에서는 SG32명, TPC 29명으로 TPC 군에서 차이가 있으며, 질환 특성 자료에서 IRC 기반 tumor location(table 14.1.4.1)에서 뇌는 SG 15명, TPC 18명으로 총 33명으로 뇌전이 환자에서의 대상자수가 서로 상이함.
segments.en_txt: - In the ITT population, there were 63 patients with prior brain radiotherapy (SG 32, TPC 31); however, in the analysis of patients with brain metastases (Brain metastasis positive Ad hoc table), the numbers were SG 32 and TPC 29, showing a discrepancy in the TPC group, and in the disease characteristics data, the IRC-based tumor location (table 14.1.4.1) showed the brain as SG 15 and TPC 18, totaling 33, indicating that the number of subjects with brain metastases differs across datasets.

segments.ko_txt: • 뇌전이가 없는 환자에서 시험 중단 대상자는 TPC 군에서 87.1%(vs. SG 68.5%)로 TPC에서 더 높았으며 이는 대부분 사망 및 동의철회에 의한 것으로 두 군에서 불균형을 보였으며 이는 SG군의 치료효과에 기인할 가능성이 있음.
segments.en_txt: • Among patients without brain metastases, the proportion of subjects who discontinued the study was higher in the TPC group at 87.1% (vs. SG 68.5%), mainly due to death and withdrawal of consent, showing an imbalance between the two groups, which may be attributable to the treatment effect in the SG group.

segments.ko_txt: AE로 인한 치료 중단은 SG군 2.6%, TPC군 3.0%로 두 군에서 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: Treatment discontinuation due to AEs was similar between the two groups (SG 2.6%, TPC 3.0%).

segments.ko_txt: • 10mg/kg 용량 설정과 관련하여 1상 임상시험에서 MTD는 12mg/kg으로 결정되었으나 해당 용량에서 많은 환자에서 용량 감량 및 투여 지연이 나타나 최대 허용 가능 용량은 8, 10mg/kg으로 결정되어 2상 초기 두 용량으로 진행되었으며 2상 파트 결과 안전성 측면에서 두 용량에서의 내약성은 양호하였고 유사하였으나, 유효성 측면에서 ORR은 8mg/kg 10%, 10mg/kg 22%로 10mg/kg에서 임상적 이익이 더 우세하여 임상 권장 용량은 10mg/kg으로 선정되어 3상 시험을 진행하였음.
segments.en_txt: • Regarding selection of the 10mg/kg dose, in the Phase 1 clinical trial the MTD was determined as 12mg/kg; however, at that dose many patients experienced dose reductions and dosing delays, and the maximum acceptable dose was determined to be 8, 10mg/kg, and Phase 2 was initially conducted with these two doses. In the Phase 2 part results, tolerability was favorable and similar at both doses in terms of safety; however, in terms of efficacy, ORR was 10% at 8mg/kg and 22% at 10mg/kg, indicating greater clinical benefit at 10mg/kg; therefore, the recommended clinical dose was selected as 10mg/kg and the Phase 3 study was conducted.

segments.ko_txt: • 제출한 3상 임상시험에서 1차 유효성 평가변수는 PFS(IRC 평가)로, 총 315건 발생시 1차 유효성 분석(뇌전이가 없는 환자 대상)하여 우월성을 입증하는 설계였으며, 총 316건(SG군 166건, TPC 150건) 발생시 분석을 수행하였음.
segments.en_txt: • In the submitted Phase 3 clinical trial, the primary efficacy endpoint was PFS (IRC assessment), designed to demonstrate superiority by conducting the primary efficacy analysis (in patients without brain metastases) upon occurrence of a total of 315 events; the analysis was performed when a total of 316 events occurred (166 in the SG group, 150 in the TPC group).

segments.ko_txt: PFS 중앙값 SG 5.6개월 vs. TPC 1.7개월, HR 0.409(95% CI 0.323, 0.519, P<0.0001)로 사전 정의한 우월성을 입증하였음.
segments.en_txt: Median PFS was 5.6 months for SG vs. 1.7 months for TPC, with HR 0.409 (95% CI 0.323, 0.519, P<0.0001), demonstrating the prespecified superiority.

segments.ko_txt: 또한 전체 ITT군엔서도 SG 4.8개월 vs. TPC 1.7개월, HR 0.433(95% CI 0.347, 0.541, P<0.0001)로 우월성을 확인하였음.
segments.en_txt: In the overall ITT population as well, superiority was confirmed with SG 4.8 months vs. TPC 1.7 months, HR 0.433 (95% CI 0.347, 0.541, P<0.0001).

segments.ko_txt: 뇌전이가 있는 환자는 SAP에서 사전 정의된 분석은 아니나 PFS 분석 결과 중앙값은 SG 2.8개월 vs. TPC 1.6개월(HR 0.650, p=0.1823)로 두 군에서 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: Although patients with brain metastases were not a prespecified analysis in the SAP, PFS analysis showed a median of 2.8 months for SG vs. 1.6 months for TPC (HR 0.650, p=0.1823), which was similar between the two groups.

segments.ko_txt: 평가 대상자수는 제한적이므로 결과 해석시 주의가 필요함.
segments.en_txt: Because the number of evaluable subjects is limited, caution is needed in interpreting the results.

segments.ko_txt: - 연령, 이전 치료 차수, 간 전이 유무, 원발성 TNBC 유무에 따른 PFS는 SG군에서 개선됨을 보이는 일관된 유효성 결과를 보였음.
segments.en_txt: - PFS by age, number of prior therapies, presence of liver metastases, and presence of primary TNBC showed consistent efficacy results indicating improvement in the SG group.

segments.ko_txt: BRCA 변이 양성인 자는 7.3%(전체 ITT 8.1%) 포함되어 PFS는 통계적 유의성은 없었으나 평가 대상자수가 제한적으로 유효성 결론을 도출하는데 한계가 있음.
segments.en_txt: BRCA mutation-positive subjects comprised 7.3% (8.1% in the overall ITT), and PFS was not statistically significant; however, due to the limited number of evaluable subjects, there are limitations in drawing efficacy conclusions.

segments.ko_txt: - 전체 ITT군에 대한 하위분석 결과는 뇌전이가 없는 ITT군과 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: - Subgroup analysis results for the overall ITT population were similar to those in the ITT population without brain metastases.

segments.ko_txt: • 2차 평가변수인 OS, ORR, 질병진행까지 시간, 반응기간, 반응까지 시간, 임상적 이익률에 있어서도 SG군에서 TPC군 보다 임상적 개선을 보였음.
segments.en_txt: • For secondary endpoints including OS, ORR, time to disease progression, duration of response, time to response, and clinical benefit rate, the SG group also showed clinical improvement compared with the TPC group.

segments.ko_txt: • 뇌전이가 있는 TNBC에서의 유효성과 관련하여,
segments.en_txt: • Regarding efficacy in TNBC with brain metastases,

segments.ko_txt: - 일반적으로 뇌전이가 있는 TNBC에서의 OS는 3~6개월로 알려져 있으며 본 시험에서 뇌전이가 있는 환자에서 대조군인 TPC에서 OS는 7.5개월, 뇌전이가 없는 환자에서 TPC에서 6.7개월로 이보다 상회하는 OS를 보였음.
segments.en_txt: - In general, OS in TNBC with brain metastases is known to be 3–6 months; in this study, OS in the control TPC group was 7.5 months in patients with brain metastases and 6.7 months in patients without brain metastases, showing OS exceeding this.

segments.ko_txt: 이는 본 시험에서 안정적 뇌전이를 보인 환자가 등록되어 영향을 미쳤을 수도 있음.
segments.en_txt: This may have been influenced by enrollment of patients with stable brain metastases in this study.

segments.ko_txt: - SG의 BBB 통과 여부에 대하여 알려져 있지 않아 주유효성 평가군은 뇌전이가 없는 환자 대상이었음.
segments.en_txt: - As it is not known whether SG crosses the BBB, the primary efficacy population comprised patients without brain metastases.

segments.ko_txt: 시험 결과 뇌전이가 있는 환자에서 PFS, OS는 두 군에서 유사하게 나타났으나 환자의 뇌전이 치료상태 등 개별 환자 상태에 따라 예후가 영향을 받을 수 있으며 본 시험에서 뇌전이 환자 대상자수는 제한적이므로 뇌전이 환자에서의 이 약의 유효성이 낮을 것으로 단정할 수 없고 뇌전이 환자에서 유효성이 일반적 뇌전이 TNBC 환자 보다 유사하거나 높을 것으로 기대됨에 따라 뇌전이 환자도 신청 약물은 치료 옵션이 될 수 있을 것으로 사료됨.
segments.en_txt: In study results, PFS and OS in patients with brain metastases were similar between the two groups; however, prognosis may be affected by individual patient conditions such as treatment status of brain metastases, and the number of brain-metastasis patients in this study was limited; therefore, it cannot be concluded that this drug has low efficacy in patients with brain metastases, and as efficacy in patients with brain metastases is expected to be similar to or higher than that in typical TNBC patients with brain metastases, the applied drug may also be a treatment option for patients with brain metastases.

segments.ko_txt: • 유효성 결과에 있어 2+ 또는 3+ 강도를 보이는 membrane cell 85% 기준으로 평가하였으며 ≥85%에서 <85%인 경우보다 더 favorable 하였음.
segments.en_txt: • For efficacy results, assessment was performed using the criterion of 85% membrane cells with intensity 2+ or 3+, and outcomes were more favorable in ≥85% than in <85%.

segments.ko_txt: 이는 SG의 기전(Trop-2 표적)을 고려하였을 때 Trop-2 발현이 있는 경우 유효성 측면에서 유리할 것으로 기대할 수 있음.
segments.en_txt: Considering the mechanism of action of SG (Trop-2 targeting), the presence of Trop-2 expression can be expected to be advantageous in terms of efficacy.

segments.ko_txt: Trop-2 발현 정도에 따른 분석은 membrane cells 2+(moderate), 3+(strong)에 대하여 수행하였으며 0 또는 weak에 대한 결과는 제시되지 않았음.
segments.en_txt: Analysis by degree of Trop-2 expression was performed for membrane cells 2+ (moderate) and 3+ (strong), and results for 0 or weak were not presented.

segments.ko_txt: Trop-2 발현 정도는 IHC로 수행하였으나 시험법은 밸리데이션되지 않았으며 대상자 선정기준으로 설정하지 않아 Trop-2 발현 정도에 따른 유효성 결론을 도출하는 데는 한계가 있음.
segments.en_txt: The degree of Trop-2 expression was assessed by IHC, but the assay was not validated and was not set as a subject selection criterion; therefore, there are limitations in deriving efficacy conclusions according to the degree of Trop-2 expression.

segments.ko_txt: 다만, SG의 기전을 고려하였을 때 Trop-2 발현시 유효성이 더 클 것으로 예측됨.
segments.en_txt: Nevertheless, considering the mechanism of action of SG, greater efficacy is predicted in the presence of Trop-2 expression.

segments.ko_txt: • 국소 진행성 환자가 시험 진행 중 계획서 변경에 따라 일부 포함되어 평가되었으며, 대상 환자는 이전 1회 이상 전이성 치료를 받은 환자이며 유방암에서 국소 진행성 또는 전이성 질환은 통상적으로 치료지침을 동일하게 적용한 점을 고려하여 신청 효능효과는 인정 가능함.
segments.en_txt: • Some locally advanced patients were included and evaluated in accordance with a protocol amendment during the conduct of the study; the target patients were those who had received at least 1 prior metastatic therapy, and considering that in breast cancer, locally advanced or metastatic disease is generally managed under the same treatment guidelines, the proposed indication can be accepted.

segments.ko_txt: <안전성>
segments.en_txt: <Safety>

segments.ko_txt: • 자료마감일 20.3.11일 기준 핵심임상시험(132-05 시험)에서 약물 관련 AE(ADR)는 SG군에서 97.7%, TPC군에서 85.7%, SAE는 SG군 26.7% vs. 27.1%으로 두 군에서 유사하였으나 약물 관련 SAE는 15.1% vs. 8.5% 및 투여 일시 중단을 초래한 AE는 62.8% vs. 38.8%로 SG군에서 더 높았음.
segments.en_txt: • As of the data cutoff date of 20.3.11, in the pivotal clinical study (Study 132-05), drug-related AEs (ADRs) were 97.7% in the SG group and 85.7% in the TPC group, and SAEs were similar between the two groups (SG 26.7% vs. 27.1%); however, drug-related SAEs were 15.1% vs. 8.5%, and AEs leading to dose interruption were 62.8% vs. 38.8%, which were higher in the SG group.

segments.ko_txt: 투여 중단을 초래한 AE는 4.7% vs. 5.4%로 두 군에서 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: AEs leading to treatment discontinuation were similar between the two groups (4.7% vs. 5.4%).

segments.ko_txt: 투여지연 비율은 SG군에서 높았으나 전체적 노출기간, 투여주기는 SG군에서 길게 나타나 용량조절을 통하여 내약성을 높일 수 있는 것으로 사료되며 이는 유효성 개선에도 영향을 미칠 수 있을 것으로 사료됨.
segments.en_txt: The rate of dose delay was higher in the SG group; however, the overall exposure duration and dosing cycles were longer in the SG group, suggesting that tolerability can be improved through dose modification, which may also affect improvements in efficacy.

- The most common AEs in the SG group were diarrhea (65.1%), nausea (62.4%), fatigue (51.6%), alopecia (46.9%), neutropenia (42.6%), anemia (39.1%), constipation (37.2%), vomiting (33.3%), decreased appetite (27.5%), decreased neutrophil count (27.5%), cough (23.6%), and abdominal pain (21.3%).

segments.ko_txt: - 3등급 이상 AE는 SG군에서 호중구감소증, 호중구수감소, 설사, 빈혈 등이었으며, TPC군에서 호중구감소증, 호중구수감소, 피로, 빈혈 등이었음.
segments.en_txt: - Grade 3 or higher AEs in the SG group included neutropenia, decreased neutrophil count, diarrhea, and anemia; in the TPC group, they included neutropenia, decreased neutrophil count, fatigue, and anemia.

segments.ko_txt: - ADR은 SG군에서 오심(57%), 설사(59.3%), 탈모(46.1%), 피로(44.6%), 호중구감소증(41.9%), 빈혈(34.1%) 등의 위장관계와 골수억제로 이리노테칸과 일치하는 이상반응이었음.
segments.en_txt: - ADRs in the SG group included nausea (57%), diarrhea (59.3%), alopecia (46.1%), fatigue (44.6%), neutropenia (41.9%), and anemia (34.1%), representing gastrointestinal events and myelosuppression consistent with irinotecan.

segments.ko_txt: - SG군에서 TPC 군보다 높게 나타난 ADR은 설사, 오심, 구토 등의 위장관계 AE, 피로, 호중구감소증, 빈혈의 혈액 및 림프계, 탈모 등이 있었음.
segments.en_txt: - ADRs that were higher in the SG group than in the TPC group included gastrointestinal AEs such as diarrhea, nausea, and vomiting; blood and lymphatic disorders such as fatigue, neutropenia, and anemia; and alopecia.

segments.ko_txt: - 자료마감일까지 총 사망은 SG군에서 66.3%, TPC 군에서 81.3%였으며 대부분 PD에 의한 사망이었으며 AE로 인한 사망은 SG군에서 3명(호흡부전 2명, 폐렴 1명, 모두 약물 관련 아님), TPC 군에서 2명이었음.
segments.en_txt: - Up to the data cutoff date, overall deaths were 66.3% in the SG group and 81.3% in the TPC group, mostly due to PD; deaths due to AEs were 3 in the SG group (respiratory failure 2, pneumonia 1; none drug-related) and 2 in the TPC group.

segments.ko_txt: 132-01, 132-05 시험 통합 분석에서 SG를 투여받은 TNBC 환자는 총 366명 중 사망은 총 261명(71.3%)였고 대부분 PD에 의한 사망(245명, 66.9%)였음.
segments.en_txt: In the pooled analysis of Studies 132-01 and 132-05, among TNBC patients treated with SG, deaths occurred in 261 of 366 patients (71.3%), mostly due to PD (245 patients, 66.9%).

segments.ko_txt: 마지막 치료후 30일 이내 AE로 인한 사망은 2명으로 호흡부전, 전이(약물 관련 아님)였음.
segments.en_txt: Deaths due to AEs within 30 days after the last treatment were 2 cases: respiratory failure and metastasis (not drug-related).

segments.ko_txt: 2편의 시험에서 SG 10mg/kg 용량으로 투여받은 모든 유형의 암환자는 660명 중 사망은 496명(75%)였고 대부분 PD에 의한 사망(450명, 68.2%)였음.
segments.en_txt: Across two studies, among all cancer types treated with SG at a dose of 10mg/kg, deaths occurred in 496 of 660 patients (75%), mostly due to PD (450 patients, 68.2%).

segments.ko_txt: 마지막 치료후 30일 이내 사망 29명 중 AE로 인한 사망은 11명(호흡부전 3명, 감염성 소장 결장염, 폐렴, CNS 전이, 척추 전이, 저산소증, 폐색전증, 호흡고통, 흡인성 폐렴 각 1명)에서 보고되었음.
segments.en_txt: Among 29 deaths within 30 days after the last treatment, deaths due to AEs were reported in 11 patients (respiratory failure 3; and infectious enterocolitis, pneumonia, CNS metastasis, spinal metastasis, hypoxia, pulmonary embolism, respiratory distress, aspiration pneumonia 1 each).

segments.ko_txt: - SAE는 약물 관련성과 상관없이 SG 26.7% vs. TPC 28.1%로 두 군에서 유사하였으며, 약물 관련성은 SG 15.1% vs. TPC 8.5%로 SG군에서 높았음.
segments.en_txt: - SAEs, regardless of causality, were similar between the two groups (SG 26.7% vs. TPC 28.1%); drug-related SAEs were higher in the SG group (SG 15.1% vs. TPC 8.5%).

segments.ko_txt: SG군에서 가장 흔한 SAE는 열성 호중구감소증, 설사, 폐렴, 발열, 호흡곤란, 흉막삼출이었으며 열성 호중구감소증, 설사, 폐렴은 SG군에서 TPC 군보다 발생빈도가 높았음.
segments.en_txt: The most common SAEs in the SG group were febrile neutropenia, diarrhea, pneumonia, pyrexia, dyspnea, and pleural effusion; febrile neutropenia, diarrhea, and pneumonia occurred more frequently in the SG group than in the TPC group.

segments.ko_txt: 132-01 및 132-05 시험 통합 시 TNBC 환자에서 27.9%, 10mg/kg으로 투여받은 모든 종류의 암 환자에서 34.7%에서 SAE 보고되었으며 132-05 시험에서의 경향과 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: When pooling Studies 132-01 and 132-05, SAEs were reported in 27.9% of TNBC patients and in 34.7% of patients with all cancer types treated at 10mg/kg, showing a trend similar to that in Study 132-05.

segments.ko_txt: • 비임상, 임상시험에서 나타난 안전성 프로파일을 고려하여 골수억제(호중구감소증, 열성 호중구감소증, 빈혈), 감염, 위장관계(설사, 오심, 구토), 과민성, 피로, 간질성폐질환, 신경병증, 피로를 관심대상 이상사례로 설정하여 3상 임상시험, 132-01, 132-05 시험 통합하여 TNBC 환자 및 SG 10mg/kg을 투여받은 모든 종류의 암 환자에 대하여 SMQ 분석을 수행하였음.
segments.en_txt: • Considering the safety profile observed in nonclinical and clinical studies, myelosuppression (neutropenia, febrile neutropenia, anemia), infection, gastrointestinal events (diarrhea, nausea, vomiting), hypersensitivity, fatigue, interstitial lung disease, neuropathy, and fatigue were designated as adverse events of special interest, and SMQ analyses were conducted by integrating the Phase 3 clinical study and pooled data from Studies 132-01 and 132-05 for TNBC patients and for patients with all cancer types treated with SG 10mg/kg.

segments.ko_txt: - 전반적으로 132-05시험의 결과와 두 시험 통합 시 TNBC 환자, 두 시험 통합 시 10mg/kg을 투여받은 모든 종류의 암환자에서 유사한 결과를 보였음.
segments.en_txt: - Overall, results were similar across Study 132-05, the pooled TNBC population from the two studies, and the pooled population of all cancer types treated with 10mg/kg from the two studies.

segments.ko_txt: - 골수억제, 위장관계는 이리노테칸의 안전성 프로파일과 일치하는 결과이며, 대부분 용량조절을 통하여 관리가능하였음.
segments.en_txt: - Myelosuppression and gastrointestinal events were consistent with the safety profile of irinotecan, and most were manageable through dose modification.

segments.ko_txt: 간질성폐질환의 경우 중대한 사례는 모든 통합분석에서 1건 있었으며 회복 중이었음
segments.en_txt: For interstitial lung disease, there was 1 serious case in all pooled analyses, and the patient was recovering.

segments.ko_txt: 관심대상 이상사례에 대하여 용량조절을 통하여 관리가능할 것으로 사료되며 이는 용법용량에 설정하였음.
segments.en_txt: The adverse events of special interest are considered manageable through dose modification, and this was reflected in the dosage and administration.

segments.ko_txt: • 혈액학적 수치는 베이스라인 대비 변화는 두 군에서 시간 경과에 따라 유사하였으며, SG군에서 TPC군보다 높게 나타난 혈액학적 수치 이상(≥5%)은 호중구수 감소, 림프구수 감소, 백혈구수 감소로 대부분 3등급에 해당하였음.
segments.en_txt: • Changes in hematologic parameters from baseline were similar over time between the two groups; hematologic abnormalities (≥5%) that were higher in the SG group than in the TPC group were decreases in neutrophil count, lymphocyte count, and white blood cell count, most of which were Grade 3.

segments.ko_txt: 생화학적 수치 이상은 주로 간 관련이었으며 두 군에서 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: Biochemical abnormalities were mainly liver-related and were similar between the two groups.

segments.ko_txt: • 132-01 및 132-05 시험 통합 분석 시 총 8명(132-01 시험에서 10mg/kg SG를 투여받은 mTNBC 5명, 다른 전이성 상피암 3명)에서 투여중단 후 30일 이내 Hy’law 기준에 해당하는 실험실 수치 이상이 있었으나 약물 유도 간손상 평가에서 간 전이 진행, 간 전이에 따른 담관 폐색, 병용약물, 담낭염 등의 다른 병인이 있어 약물 유도 간손상 사례는 없었음.
segments.en_txt: • In the pooled analysis of Studies 132-01 and 132-05, a total of 8 patients (5 with mTNBC who received 10mg/kg SG in Study 132-01, and 3 with other metastatic epithelial cancers) had laboratory abnormalities meeting Hy’s law criteria within 30 days after discontinuation; however, in the assessment of drug-induced liver injury, other etiologies were identified such as progression of liver metastases, biliary obstruction due to liver metastases, concomitant medications, and cholecystitis, and there were no cases of drug-induced liver injury.

segments.ko_txt: • QTcF 연장과 관련하여 132-05 시험에서 QTcF > 500ms은 SG 0.8%(2명) vs. 0.4%(1명)으로 두 군에서 유사하였으며, 변화량 > 30ms 18.2% vs. 11.2%, > 60 ms 4.3% vs. 1.8%로 SG군에서 높았음.
segments.en_txt: • Regarding QTcF prolongation, in Study 132-05, QTcF > 500ms was similar between the two groups (SG 0.8% [2 patients] vs. 0.4% [1 patient]); however, the proportions with a change > 30ms (18.2% vs. 11.2%) and > 60 ms (4.3% vs. 1.8%) were higher in the SG group.

segments.ko_txt: QTcF > 500ms 및/또는 > 60 ms인 대상자에서 심장전문의 평가 결과 QTc를 연장시키는 것으로 알려진 약물을 병용하고 있었음.
segments.en_txt: In subjects with QTcF > 500ms and/or > 60 ms, cardiology assessment indicated concomitant use of drugs known to prolong QTc.

segments.ko_txt: PK-QTcF 분석에서 ΔQTcF에 있어 free SN-38 및 SN-38G, 총 SN-38, SG의 경우 very weak positive를 보여 이 약이 QTcF 연장을 유도하는 명백한 근거는 없는 것으로 사료됨.
segments.en_txt: In the PK-QTcF analysis, for ΔQTcF, free SN-38 and SN-38G, total SN-38, and SG showed a very weak positive association, and it is considered that there is no clear evidence that this drug induces QTcF prolongation.

segments.ko_txt: 132-01, 132-05 시험 통합 시 132-05 시험에서의 SG군에서의 결과와 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: Upon pooling Studies 132-01 and 132-05, results were similar to those for the SG group in Study 132-05.

segments.ko_txt: • 132-05 시험에서의 면역원성 분석이 수행 중으로 현재 이용 불가함.
segments.en_txt: • Immunogenicity analysis for Study 132-05 is ongoing and is currently unavailable.

segments.ko_txt: 132-01 시험에서 mTNBC 환자 106명으로부터 수집된 혈청 샘플의 SG 면역원성 분석에서 2%(2/106)에서 치료 후 발생한 항-약물 항체(ADA; 요법 종료시 양성 지속)가 발생했음.
segments.en_txt: In Study 132-01, immunogenicity analysis of SG in serum samples collected from 106 mTNBC patients showed treatment-emergent anti-drug antibodies (ADA; positive persisted at end of regimen) in 2% (2/106).

segments.ko_txt: • UGT1A1 대립유전자형과 관련하여,
segments.en_txt: • With regard to the UGT1A1 allele genotype,

segments.ko_txt: - 132-05 시험에서 UGT1A1 유전형에서 전체 노출기간은 모든 유형에서 유사하였으나, 용량감량은 *28/28에서 높았음.
segments.en_txt: - In Study 132-05, overall exposure duration was similar across all UGT1A1 genotypes; however, dose reduction was higher in *28/28.

segments.ko_txt: 이는 SN-38의 대사를 UGT1A가 매개함에 따라 *28/28에서 이 효소 활성이 억제되어 노출도 증가와 일치하는 현상임.
segments.en_txt: This is consistent with increased exposure because SN-38 metabolism is mediated by UGT1A, and enzyme activity is reduced in *28/28.

segments.ko_txt: - SAE는 UGT1A1 대립유전자 *28/28에서 SAE 38.2%, 약물 관련 SAE 29.4%, 용량감량을 유도한 AE 35.3%, 영구중단을 유도한 AE 5.9%로 다른 대립유전자 유형 보다 더 높았음.
segments.en_txt: - In UGT1A1 allele *28/28, SAE was 38.2%, drug-related SAE 29.4%, AE leading to dose reduction 35.3%, and AE leading to permanent discontinuation 5.9%, which were higher than in other allele types.

segments.ko_txt: - 132-05 시험에서 호중구감소증, 설사, 빈혈, 식욕감소, 기침, 변비, 말초부종, 열성호중구감소증, 점막 염증에서 *28/28 동형접합성에서 다른 유전형에 비하여 발생빈도가 높았으며, 132-05, 132-01 두 시험 통합 시 빈혈, 열성 호중구감소증, 호중구감소증, 식욕감소는 *28/28 동형접합성에서 더 높았음.
segments.en_txt: - In Study 132-05, neutropenia, diarrhea, anemia, decreased appetite, cough, constipation, peripheral edema, febrile neutropenia, and mucosal inflammation occurred more frequently in *28/28 homozygotes than in other genotypes; when pooling Studies 132-05 and 132-01, anemia, febrile neutropenia, neutropenia, and decreased appetite were higher in *28/28 homozygotes.

segments.ko_txt: 구토, 오심, 설사 등 위장관계 AE는 유사하였음.
segments.en_txt: Gastrointestinal AEs such as vomiting, nausea, and diarrhea were similar.

segments.ko_txt: - SN-38은 SG의 저분자의 세포독성 부분으로 UGT1A1에 의해 글루쿠로니드화되어 불활성 SN-38G로 대사됨.
segments.en_txt: - SN-38 is the low-molecular cytotoxic moiety of SG and is glucuronidated by UGT1A1 and metabolized to inactive SN-38G.

segments.ko_txt: UGT1A1은 효소 활성에 영향을 받는 대립유전자 변이가 있는 효소로 UGT1A1*28 대립유전형인 경우 SN-38 대사를 억제하여 노출도가 높아질 수 있음.
segments.en_txt: UGT1A1 is an enzyme with allelic variants affecting enzymatic activity; in the case of the UGT1A1*28 allele genotype, SN-38 metabolism may be reduced, resulting in increased exposure.

segments.ko_txt: 다만, popPK 분석에서 UGT1A1*28 대립유전형에 따른 free SN-38 노출도(AUC, Cmax) 차이는 없었음.
segments.en_txt: However, in the popPK analysis, there were no differences in free SN-38 exposure (AUC, Cmax) according to the UGT1A1*28 allele genotype.

segments.ko_txt: UGT1A1*28 동형접합성은 아프리카 아메리칸계 흑인에서 20%, 백인 10%, 동아시아인 2%에서 발현되는 것으로 알려져 있음.
segments.en_txt: UGT1A1*28 homozygosity is reported to occur in 20% of African American Blacks, 10% of Whites, and 2% of East Asians.

segments.ko_txt: 시험 수행 시 UGT1A1*28 대립유전자 검사는 의무가 아니었으며 SG군에서만 일부 수행되었음.
segments.en_txt: During study conduct, testing for the UGT1A1*28 allele was not mandatory and was performed only in some patients in the SG group.

segments.ko_txt: *28/28 동형접합성인 경우 다른 유형에서 보다 3등급 이상 AE, SAE, 용량감량, 일시중단 등의 사례가 높았고, 132-052 시험에서 호중구감소증, 설사, 빈혈, 말초부종, 열성 호중구감소증, 식욕감소 등의 AE가 더 높게 발행하였음.
segments.en_txt: In *28/28 homozygotes, cases of Grade 3 or higher AEs, SAEs, dose reduction, and temporary interruption were higher than in other types, and in Study 132-052, AEs such as neutropenia, diarrhea, anemia, peripheral edema, febrile neutropenia, and decreased appetite occurred at higher rates.

segments.ko_txt: 따라서 허가사항에 이에 대한 정보를 제공하고 해당하는 경우 면밀한 모니터링이 필요함.
segments.en_txt: Therefore, it is necessary to provide information on this in the labeling and to conduct close monitoring where applicable.

segments.ko_txt: • 종합적으로, 이전 전신치료후 재발 또는 불응인 전이성 TNBC는 예후가 좋지 않으며 현재 mTNBC 환자에서 카페시타빈, 에리불린, 비노렐빈 등의 단독요법이 사용되고 있으며 이들 환자에서 ORR 10~15%, PFS 2~3개월로 추정됨.
segments.en_txt: • Overall, metastatic TNBC that relapses or is refractory after prior systemic therapy has a poor prognosis, and currently monotherapies such as capecitabine, eribulin, and vinorelbine are used in mTNBC patients, with ORR estimated at 10–15% and PFS at 2–3 months in these patients.

segments.ko_txt: 신청 질환 대상자 대항 3상 임상시험에서 1차 유효성 평가변수인 PFS 5.6개월(뇌전이 없는 경우)로 대조군 대비 우월성을 입증하였으며, ORR 34.9%(뇌전이 없는 경우), OS 11.8개월로 대조군 대비 개선됨을 보여 유효성을 확인하였음.
segments.en_txt: In the Phase 3 clinical study in the indicated population, the primary efficacy endpoint PFS was 5.6 months (in patients without brain metastases), demonstrating superiority versus the control group, and efficacy was confirmed by improvements versus the control group with ORR 34.9% (in patients without brain metastases) and OS 11.8 months.

segments.ko_txt: 다만, 신청 질환 중 국소 진행성 환자는 제한적으로(ITT군에서 15명 등록, 2.8%)되어 유효성 평가에 적절하지 않으므로 전이성 질환으로 제한하는 것이 타당함.
segments.en_txt: However, patients with locally advanced disease among the indicated condition were limited (15 enrolled in the ITT population, 2.8%) and are not appropriate for efficacy evaluation; therefore, it is appropriate to limit to metastatic disease.

segments.ko_txt: 안전성 측면에서 SG의 대사체인 SN-38이 이리노테칸의 활성 대사체로 이리노테칸의 독성과 일치하는 위장관계, 골수독성이 주요 독성으로 나타났고 UGT1A1의 *28 대립유전자 동형접합자에서 다른 유전자형에 비하여 설사가 더 많이 보고되었으며 이는 용량조절, 모니터링을 통애 관리 가능함.
segments.en_txt: From a safety perspective, SN-38, a metabolite of SG, is the active metabolite of irinotecan, and gastrointestinal and bone marrow toxicities consistent with irinotecan toxicity were the major toxicities; diarrhea was reported more frequently in UGT1A1 *28 allele homozygotes than in other genotypes, which can be managed through dose modification and monitoring.

segments.ko_txt: 따라서 신청 품목은 이전에 두 번 이상의 전신치료를 바은 적이 있고, 이 중 적어도 한 번은 전이성 질환에서 치료받은 절제 불가능한 전이성 삼중음성유방암 성인 환자의 치료에 대하여 안전성‧유효성 측면에서 허가에 적합한 것으로 판단됨.
segments.en_txt: Therefore, the applied product is considered appropriate for approval in terms of safety and efficacy for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable metastatic triple-negative breast cancer who have received at least two prior systemic therapies, including at least one for metastatic disease.
• United States (FDA): 2021.04.07. / Europe (EMA): 2021.11.23.
